identification: Tasmanian/Australian two-door wardrobe c1890-1900, figured birdseye Huon pine veneered doors, stiles and frieze, with two full-length bevelled mirror plates in the doors, red/cedar-toned moulded cornice, plinth base. Interior: vertical boarded pine (knotty, Baltic/radiata-type) back, Huon pine hat rail with brass hooks, single long blanket drawer inside at base with brass recessed/flush campaign-style pulls. Pierced brass hinges/escutcheon. Catalogue size H198 W135 D50 cm. Mid-range plain colonial example, not a maker piece.
